summary_english: Wash, keep clean, and wear white clothing when going to church.
summary_amharic: ከእንቅልፍ በኋላ ታጥቦ፣ ንጽሕናን ጠብቆ ነጭ ልብስ ለብሶ ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መሄድ።

summary_english: Step onto the church grounds with the right foot first.
summary_amharic: በቤተ ክርስቲያን ግቢ ያለውን ደረጃ በቀኝ እግር መጀመር።
review_note: The source term “መቃምድር” is unclear; confirm its spelling and meaning before publication.

summary_english: Kiss the church door when entering.
summary_amharic: ሲገቡ የቤተ ክርስቲያኑን በር መሳለም።
review_note: The source reads “ወደ ውጥ,” which appears inconsistent; verify the intended word.

summary_english: Bow three times and make the sign of the Cross at the sanctuary door.
summary_amharic: በቤተ መቅደሱ በር ሦስት ጊዜ መስገድና የመስቀል ምልክት ማድረግ።
review_note: The source has “ወል” and “በማማተብ”; verify these forms against the original before publication.

summary_english: Offer the greeting of peace to the church.
summary_amharic: ለቤተ ክርስቲያን የሰላምታ ጸሎት ማቅረብ።
review_note: The phrase “ተጽፈሻልና” is retained from the source; confirm the intended nuance of “depicted.”

summary_english: Give thanks for protection, health, and the light of this day.
summary_amharic: እስከ ዛሬ ስለተሰጠው ጥበቃ፣ ጤናና ብርሃን ምስጋና ማቅረብ።
review_note: The source heading is “ምጋና” and includes “የመገነን”; verify the latter phrase. The English translation marks that omission explicitly.

summary_english: Ask for blessing, health, and protection from trials.
summary_amharic: ለቀሪው ዘመን በረከት፣ ጤናና ከፈተና ጥበቃ መለመን።
review_note: The source contains “ከእስከ አሁኑ”; verify the intended comparative wording.

summary_english: Prayer thanks the Creator and seeks forgiveness of sin.
summary_amharic: ጸሎት ፈጣሪን ማመስገንና የኃጢአት ስርየት መለመን ነው።

summary_english: The seven daily prayer times and prayer at church.
summary_amharic: ሰባቱ የቀን ጸሎት ጊዜያትና በቤተ ክርስቲያን የሚደረግ ጸሎት።
review_note: The parenthetical claims about midnight and the Psalm numbering are retained from the supplied English source and need ecclesiastical review.

summary_english: The three kinds are private, family, and public prayer.
summary_amharic: የግል፣ የቤተሰብና የማኅበር ጸሎት ሦስቱ ዓይነቶች ናቸው።

summary_english: Prayer offered privately at home or another suitable place.
summary_amharic: በቤት ወይም በተስማሚ ቦታ በግል የሚደረግ ጸሎት።

summary_english: Prayer offered together by family members.
summary_amharic: የቤተሰብ አባላት በአንድነት የሚያቀርቡት ጸሎት።

summary_english: Prayer offered by clergy and laity gathered together.
summary_amharic: ካህናትና ምእመናን ተሰብስበው የሚያቀርቡት ጸሎት።
review_note: Several source citations and the description of the earliest gathering places may need verification.

summary_english: Saatat and hymns are conducted in churches and monasteries.
summary_amharic: ሰዓታት በገዳማትና በትልልቅ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ይደረጋል፤ ዝማሬም በአንድነት ይቀርባል።
review_note: The source spells “Seatati,” “Abba Georgia,” and “Tsenat͟sili”; review transliterations and exact liturgical claims.

summary_english: Prayers conducted by priests with the participation of the laity.
summary_amharic: ካህናት ከምእመናን ጋር የሚያደርጉት የተለያዩ ጸሎቶች።

summary_english: Liturgical prayer is described in three parts.
summary_amharic: የቅዳሴ ጸሎት ሦስት ክፍሎች አሉት።
review_note: The source gives English incipits only. Verify established Amharic liturgical wording rather than publishing these back-translated incipits as canonical text.

summary_english: A list of fourteen anaphoras used for Holy Communion.
summary_amharic: ቅዱስ ቁርባን የሚከበርባቸው አሥራ አራት አናፎራዎች።
review_note: Names are translated from the supplied English list; verify official Amharic names and order.

summary_english: Standing, clothing, and facing east during prayer.
summary_amharic: በጸሎት ጊዜ መቆም፣ መልበስና ወደ ምሥራቅ መመልከት።

summary_english: Making the sign of the Cross at the beginning and end of prayer.
summary_amharic: በጸሎት መጀመሪያና መጨረሻ የመስቀል ምልክት ማድረግ።
review_note: The hand-position description and English formula are from the supplied source; verify accepted Amharic wording.

summary_english: Praying humbly and quietly with attention on God.
summary_amharic: በትሕትናና በዝምታ መጸለይ፣ ሐሳብንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ማቅረብ።

summary_english: A prayer for mercy during times of trouble.
summary_amharic: በችግር ጊዜ በጾምና በጸሎት ምሕረትን መለመን።

summary_english: Prayer that the Church offers for the dead.
summary_amharic: ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለሙታን የምታቀርበው ጸሎት።
review_note: Source citations vary between Didasc. Arts. 33 and 22; “Barock” and “Lk. 20:3739” appear as given. Verify citations and theological wording before publication.

summary_english: Days of commemoration and prayers for the dead.
summary_amharic: ለሙታን የመታሰቢያ ቀናትና በእነሱ የሚደረጉ ጸሎቶች።
review_note: Verify the commemorative days and cited article with an authorized reviewer.

summary_english: The Church prays for people, peace, and many needs.
summary_amharic: ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለሕዝብ፣ ለሰላምና ለተለያዩ ፍላጎቶች ትጸልያለች።
